summary: Lo-fi in one effect, with zero latency: bit-depth reduction (1 to 24 bits, fractional, optional TPDF dither), sample-and-hold rate reduction down to 200 Hz with an optional anti-alias filter and hold-clock jitter, hiss (optionally following the input), vinyl crackle, light wow, flutter and drift, a tone control, Mix, Output and an Amount knob for the strength of the whole effect (0 to 200 %). A fresh instance is lo-fi at once: 8 bits held at 12 kHz. Everything is smoothed; with every stage off, or Mix or Amount at 0, the input passes bit for bit. Use it for 8-bit and early-sampler grit, cassette and radio colour, dusty vinyl, telephone and small-speaker sounds.
use_for: Lo-fi character, zero latency: bit and rate reduction, hiss, vinyl crackle, wow, flutter and drift, for 8-bit grit, cassette, dusty vinyl, radio and telephone sounds.

parameters.name: Bits
parameters.description: Word length of the output in bits; 24 is off. Fractional values give a fractional number of levels
parameters.how: Sets the word length from 1 to 24 bits, in fractions of a bit; 24 turns the crusher off.
parameters.sound: Fewer bits give coarser steps: at 12 it is grainy on quiet parts, at 8 it is gritty, at 4 and below it is a harsh buzz of noise and distortion.

parameters.name: Dither
parameters.description: TPDF dither (one step peak to peak each side) before the rounding
parameters.how: Adds triangular dither before the bit reduction.
parameters.sound: Off the quantisation error is crunchy distortion that follows the signal; on it turns into a smooth hiss, and quiet tails stay alive.

parameters.name: Rate
parameters.description: Sample-and-hold rate in Hz (12 kHz at first); at or above the host's sample rate it is off
parameters.how: Sets the rate the signal is held at, from 200 Hz up; the top of the range, at or above the song's sample rate, turns the reducer off.
parameters.sound: Lower rates sound crunchy and metallic as the top end folds back into the audible range; very low rates turn music into an electronic toy.

parameters.name: Anti-alias
parameters.description: A steep low-pass (12th-order Butterworth, 0.40 of the hold rate) before the hold
parameters.how: Filters everything above the new Nyquist frequency away before the hold.
parameters.sound: Off, the fold-over aliasing makes the sound harsh and inharmonic; on, the sound is duller but clean, like a period sampler's output filter.

parameters.name: Jitter
parameters.description: Random timing error of the hold clock (up to 25% of a hold period at 100%)
parameters.how: Shakes the moment each sample is taken by a small random amount.
parameters.sound: A little roughens the aliasing into noise; more adds a rough, unstable grain.

parameters.name: Hiss
parameters.description: Hiss level in dBFS (RMS); off at its minimum
parameters.how: Adds a steady hiss from -90 to -20 dB, or turns it off at the minimum.
parameters.sound: A little hiss gives a worn tape or old preamp feel; more covers quiet passages.

parameters.name: Hiss follow
parameters.description: The hiss follows the input's level, and closes when the input is silent (below -70 dBFS)
parameters.how: Makes the hiss follow the loudness of the input, gated off when nothing plays.
parameters.sound: The hiss rises and falls with the music, like noise that comes from the signal itself; silence stays silent.

parameters.name: Crackle
parameters.how: Sets how many pops per second are added, from 0 to 100.
parameters.sound: A few pops a second sound like a dusty record; many sound like a worn one.

parameters.name: Crackle level
parameters.description: Peak level of the loudest pops in dBFS
parameters.how: Sets the level of the crackle pops, from -60 to -6 dB.
parameters.sound: Low levels are a faint dust under the music; high levels are loud clicks.

parameters.name: Wow
parameters.description: Slow pitch variation: peak deviation in cents (the modulated read delays the sound by a few ms, never reported as latency)
parameters.how: Sets a slow pitch wobble of up to 50 cents.
parameters.sound: It gives a worn, unstable tape or turntable feel, with slow bending of long notes.

parameters.name: Wow rate
parameters.how: Sets the speed of the slow pitch wobble, from 0.3 to 6 Hz.
parameters.sound: Slow rates drift lazily and faster ones sound like a warble.

parameters.name: Flutter
parameters.description: Fast pitch variation (7.3 and 11.9 Hz): peak deviation in cents
parameters.how: Sets a fast pitch wobble of up to 50 cents.
parameters.sound: It adds a fine, nervous shimmer to the pitch, like a tired transport.

parameters.name: Drift
parameters.description: Very slow random detune (three incommensurate slow waves, 0.12 to 0.31 Hz): peak deviation in cents
parameters.how: Sets a very slow, irregular detune of up to 25 cents.
parameters.sound: The pitch wanders slowly and never repeats exactly, like an unsteady oscillator or a warped record.

parameters.name: Tone
parameters.description: After the chain: left of centre a low-pass (20 kHz down to 600 Hz), right of centre a high-frequency lift (up to 9 dB)
parameters.how: Tilts the tone after everything else: darker to the left, brighter to the right, flat in the middle.
parameters.sound: Turn it down to soften the harsh edges of the crushing; turn it up to bring back air.

parameters.name: Mix
parameters.description: Dry/wet (the dry signal is not delayed: there is no latency)
parameters.how: Blends the processed signal with the dry input.
parameters.sound: Lower values keep the original and add the lo-fi as a layer.

parameters.name: Output
parameters.how: Sets the final level in dB, from -24 to +24.
parameters.sound: It makes the sound louder or quieter without changing its character.

parameters.name: Amount
parameters.description: Effect strength: how strong the whole effect is, 100 % = the settings as they stand, 0 = clean (bit for bit the input), 200 % = exaggerated
parameters.how: Scales every active stage at once on a perceptual scale: bits removed and rate reduction in octaves, hiss and crackle level in dB, the depth of wow, flutter and drift, the tone cut. Mix still blends the dry back in.
parameters.sound: Turn it down to hear the lo-fi fade out of the sound without changing its character, and up to push every stage further; at 0 the sound is clean.
